artboards.title: 2 · Footer line only — the diagram stays clean
3 · Pointer over a lifeline reveals its count
4 · Popover — opened by clicking the count

annotations.text:
Phase 1 viewer states, left to right.
1 Default: flag off, lookup failed, or no accessible related page → the macro is unchanged (only the existing 'Created by' line).
2 Footer line only: one quiet line on the left of the existing attribution row, same 12px/#6b7280. The diagram itself shows nothing extra.
3 Pointer over a lifeline's box reveals that lifeline's count pill (18px, top-right corner). Moving away hides it. Nothing opens, nothing is covered.
4 Click on the pill opens the popover: 'Possibly related by name', page title (link), space key, and the label variant used there when it differs. Closes on Escape, click outside, or a second click. The open lifeline keeps its pill and a #0052CC outline.
5 Fullscreen: same footer row pinned to the bottom, same hover → pill → click → popover.

Progressive reveal, three levels of intent: read (nothing), hover (a count), click (the list). A presenter moving the mouse across the diagram sees at most one 18px pill; a popover never opens without a click. Keyboard: pills are buttons, revealed on focus. Touch: the first tap reveals the pill, the second opens.

Copy stays on the cautious side: 'also appear in', 'Possibly related by name', and a one-line reminder in the popover footer 'Same name, not proof of the same object'. No 'confirm' / 'not the same' controls in Phase 1.
All values are lifted from the shipped viewer CSS: card 8px radius + #E5E7EB, popover 8px + 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12) (OverflowMenu recipe), links #0052CC, highlight stroke #0052CC on the actor whose pill is open.
